title: When the Vow Breaks
author: Kestrel Almeida
blurb: Quentin Okafor, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the bakery lease runs out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
